feed.title: Lockheed Martin lands $1B+ in new defense contracts
feed.summary: Lockheed Martin has secured over $1 billion in new and modified defense contracts from the Department of Defense. These contracts include funding for infrared tracking systems for Navy F/A-18 Super Hornet fighter jets, upgrades for F-35 fighter jets, missile-defense systems for Japanese warships, and electromechanical actuator units for U.S. Air Force F-16 fighter jets. feed.title: Medtronic's 49-Year Dividend Streak Faces a New Challenge: Is Growth Finally the Real Story?
feed.summary: Medtronic (MDT), known for its 49-year dividend streak, is experiencing a shift in its investment thesis due to remarkable growth in its cardiac ablation solutions, which grew 88% worldwide. feed.title: If You'd Invested $1,000 in Broadcom's 2009 IPO, Here's How Much You'd Have Today
feed.summary: Broadcom's IPO in 2009 at a split-adjusted price of $1.50 per share would have turned a $1,000 investment into approximately $220,000 today, factoring in stock appreciation. feed.title: AbbVie Just Won FDA Approval for a Once-Daily Parkinson's Pill. Here's Why It Matters More Than You Think.
feed.summary: AbbVie recently received FDA approval for Juvmo (tavapadon), a new once-daily Parkinson's pill. feed.title: Is Pantene Cream To Mist Launch Require Action From P&G Stock Investors?
